name: Jotform
tagline: Form builder with payments, approvals, apps, tables, and workflow tools

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Bronze listed at $39/month monthly and $34/month annually.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.limits: 5 active forms, 100 submissions/month, 100MB upload space, 1,000 form views/month, 500 stored submissions, 10 payment submissions/month, 1 user, and Jotform branding

tiers.name: Bronze
tiers.limits: 25 active forms, 1,000 submissions/month, 1GB upload space, and 100 payment submissions/month

tiers.name: Silver
tiers.limits: 50 active forms, 2,500 submissions/month, 10GB upload space, and 250 payment submissions/month

tiers.name: Gold
tiers.limits: 100 active forms, 10,000 submissions/month, 100GB upload space, 1,000 payment submissions/month, and optional HIPAA features

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.limits: Multiuser plan with custom or unlimited usage, SSO, custom domains, enhanced security and enterprise administration

pricing.freeTierCaps: 5 active forms; 100 submissions/month; 100MB upload space; 1,000 form views/month; 500 stored submissions; 10 payment submissions/month; 1 user; Jotform branding
pricing.billingTerms: monthly + annual, both auto-renewing; no paid-plan trial; 30-day money-back guarantee
pricing.hiddenCosts: Promotional annual discounts renew at the full price in the next payment period. Taxes are added unless exempt. A dedicated AI-agent phone number is a separate recurring add-on with an unpublished price. If total submission storage is exceeded, Jotform may delete the oldest response to make room for new ones.

verdictSummary: Basic forms are easy, but Jotform's broad widget library, payments, approvals, PDF generation, tables, apps, and compliance options create a large surface.
coreLoopDIY: Build form creation, public forms, response storage, notifications, CSV export, and optional payment widgets.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because forms become mini business processes without custom coding.

priorArt.name: OhMyForm
priorArt.desc: Open-source form builder prior art; useful for a simpler Jotform alternative.

rejectedAlternatives.name: Budibase
rejectedAlternatives.desc: Apps, tables, approvals, and workflows are there; payments are not, and PDF export is paid

rejectedAlternatives.name: Forminator
rejectedAlternatives.desc: Forms and payments are strong; approvals, apps, and database tables are not part of the product

rejectedAlternatives.name: OhMyForm
rejectedAlternatives.desc: Everyone still recommends it; the repo was archived in 2024 and the last real code is roughly five years old

notes: Good kinda: forms are easy, business-form sprawl is not.
prompt:
Build me a personal form builder to replace Jotform. Requirements:

- Node + Express + better-sqlite3. Two surfaces: an admin UI bound to localhost for
  building forms, and public form pages at /f/<slug> for anyone with the link.
- Form definitions stored as JSON in SQLite. Field types: text, email, textarea,
  select, checkbox, date, and file upload (files to an uploads/ folder, 10 MB cap).
- Server-side required-field and email-format validation, a per-form thank-you
  message, plus a honeypot field and a per-IP rate limit to keep bot spam out.
- Every submission stored with timestamp and form version; an admin table view per
  form with CSV export of all responses.
- Email me each submission as a plain-text summary via SMTP (creds in .env).
- Only the public form pages are exposed; admin stays on localhost. No user
  accounts, no telemetry.
- Out of scope: payment collection, PDF generation, approval workflows, and a
  widget catalog. The field types above are the whole palette.
- README: how to put the public side behind a reverse proxy and where uploads live.
